The bar below is stricter than the one in VALUE_CONTRACT and VALUE_AMEND_1 and is applied to all of their claims as an added verdict; their own verdicts are still reported.

bar.rule: DECISIVE WIN for the certified decoder on a model and task only if all hold: (1) its accuracy exceeds the strongest same-budget sampling baseline (sc-8 on GSM8K, bo8-filter on MBPP) by at least 3.0 percentage points with exact McNemar p < 0.05; (2) it exceeds greedy by at least 3.0 points with p < 0.05; (3) it exceeds its random-branch control with p < 0.05. A significant win that misses a 3.0-point margin is SMALL WIN. A significant loss on (1) or (2) is LOSS. Anything else is TIE.
bar.why: p < 0.05 alone can be met by a gain too small to matter; 3 points on these sizes is the smallest gain worth deploying a different decoder for.

speed: interim tallies may be posted from finished shards' job logs while runs are in progress, always labelled interim, with the number of problems behind them; no verdict and no claim is drawn from an interim tally.
